scenario: Carry task and tenant identity through nested provider calls
procedure_reference: Execute nested provider calls under the same task context
expected_result: Each provider admission uses the same task and tenant identity
required_evidence: Task context and tenant admission snapshot
notes: Synthetic-only scenario; no real identity or multi-process context propagation

preconditions: One read slot is occupied; two callers are waiting
procedure_reference: Release the occupied slot after enqueuing priorities 0 and 10
notes: Priority direction and mapping are caller policy, not a business recommendation

preconditions: Low-priority caller waits longer than later higher-priority caller
procedure_reference: Advance the injected monotonic clock and release a slot
expected_result: Older waiter effective priority can overtake later work
notes: Aging interval is a code default, not a latency guarantee

scenario: Reject same-tenant admission above configured cap
preconditions: Tenant A has one active call and per-domain cap is one
procedure_reference: Submit a second A call and an independent B call
expected_result: Second A call is rejected while B can use free capacity
notes: Quota is local to one Adapter instance and one operation domain

preconditions: One tenant occupies all read slots; write capacity remains free
procedure_reference: Submit write from same and another tenant
expected_result: Write domain admission is unaffected by read occupancy
notes: No cluster-wide or Provider-side quota is measured

preconditions: Read domain is full and a cancellable caller is waiting
expected_result: Waiter is removed and no provider callback runs
notes: Cancellation is cooperative at queue and call boundaries

preconditions: Task cancellation event is already set
expected_result: ProviderTaskCancelledError is raised before callback invocation
notes: Synchronous in-flight provider calls cannot be forcibly interrupted

scenario: Reject expired task before provider work
preconditions: Task timeout is zero or deadline has elapsed
notes: Task deadline does not replace provider socket timeout

scenario: Stop retries when deadline expires during backoff
preconditions: First provider attempt returns a transient error; deadline expires during delay
procedure_reference: Run retry loop with injected monotonic clock
expected_result: No next retry is issued after deadline
notes: A timeout after submission may leave provider outcome unknown

scenario: Do not retry cancellation or deadline failures
preconditions: Task is cancelled or deadline expires between attempts
expected_result: Terminal task-control error propagates without spending another retry
required_evidence: Retry budget used/remaining and exception type

scenario: Use FIFO for equal effective priorities
preconditions: Two callers have equal effective priority
procedure_reference: Enqueue in a known order and release one slot
notes: FIFO applies only when effective priorities tie

scenario: Fail when admission wait budget expires
preconditions: Domain capacity or tenant cap remains occupied
procedure_reference: Wait with finite bulkhead acquisition timeout
expected_result: ProviderBulkheadFullError is raised and waiter is removed
notes: Wait budget is a local admission timeout, not task deadline

preconditions: Tenant limit is blank/nonpositive or aging interval is nonpositive
expected_result: Invalid configuration fails before provider work
notes: No production capacity values are proposed

scenario: Keep breaker and retry budget behavior unchanged
preconditions: Fair scheduler is enabled with existing circuit and budget controls
procedure_reference: Inject transient failure and retry exhaustion
expected_result: Circuit and aggregate budget retain prior semantics
required_evidence: Circuit snapshot and retry budget counters

preconditions: One task active and another queued
expected_result: Snapshot reports capacity, active and waiting counts by tenant
notes: No task payload or credentials are included
